sources.note: Village of Cambridge charter, Title 24 Appendix V.S.A. chapter 213, section 21 (official text, Vermont General Assembly): three Trustees are chosen by ballot at the village's annual meeting, for one-year terms. Structure only: the village publishes no official roster on any website found, so no holder is recorded rather than guessed from an unofficial lead.
